integrity: Theorem supported by analytical necessity/sufficiency proof and finite arithmetic/ODE checks; bibliographic priority remains open to independent investigation. No third-party paper text reproduced.
scientific_limitations: Weak single-jump amplitude damping at fixed finite duration; leading first-order state infidelity only. The general jump-variance law and fixed pole-dwell examples are established prior results; the complete speed-constrained two-error attainable region and constructive converse are the new claims. Hardware slew limits, additional baths and finite damping not addressed.
title: The exact speed-limited error-pair region for an amplitude-damped qubit inversion
